consequence.statement: Local Redirect Policies without an explicit skipRedirectFromBackend setting will now redirect traffic from node-local backends back to themselves when using socket-based load-balancing, changing the traffic forwarding behavior.

original.statement: Local Redirect Policy with socket-based load-balancing now redirects traffic from node-local backends destined to the policy's frontend back to the node-local backends by default; set skipRedirectFromBackend to true to override this.

decision.reason: [ev-fbe2aedc4ddc] says that with socket-based load-balancing, Local Redirect Policy now sends traffic from policy-selected node-local backends that is headed for the policy's frontend back to the node-local backends. This is on by default and can be turned off with skipRedirectFromBackend=true. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured; traffic still flows, only by a different path. That makes it a behavior-change for review, and medium severity is reasonable. One small inaccuracy: the proposed statement shortens the rule to backends sending traffic "back to themselves" and leaves out "destined to the policy's frontend", but the kind and class are correct.
